title: Skeleton-to-Image Encoding: Enabling Skeleton Representation Learning via Vision-Pretrained Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.05963v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large-scale pretrained vision models have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a wide range of downstream tasks, including cross-modal and multi-modal scenarios. However, their direct application to 3D human skeleton data remains challenging due to fundamental differences in data format. Moreover, the scarcity of large-scale skeleton datasets and the need to incorporate skeleton data into multi-modal action recognition without introducing additional model branches present significant research opportunities. To address these challenges, we introduce Skeleton-to-Image Encoding (S2I), a novel representation that transforms skeleton sequences into image-like data by partitioning and arranging joints based on body-part semantics and resizing to standardized image dimensions. translated_title: 骨架到图像编码：借助视觉预训练模型实现骨架表示学习
translated_abstract: 近期大规模预训练视觉模型在广泛的下游任务中展现出令人印象深刻的能力，包括跨模态和多模态场景。然而，由于数据格式上的根本差异，将这些模型直接应用于3D人体骨架数据仍然具有挑战性。此外，大规模骨架数据集的稀缺性，以及在不引入额外模型分支的情况下将骨架数据融入多模态动作识别的需求，为研究提供了重要机遇。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了骨架到图像编码，这是一种新颖的表示方法，通过基于身体部位语义对关节进行划分和排列，并调整至标准化的图像尺寸，将骨架序列转换为类图像数据。这种编码首次使得强大的视觉预训练模型能够用于自监督骨架表示学习。
tldr: 提出骨架到图像编码（S2I）方法，通过基于身体部位语义的关节划分与排列将骨架序列转换为类图像数据，首次实现利用视觉预训练模型进行自监督骨架表示学习，并可在无需额外模型分支的情况下将骨架数据融入多模态动作识别。
en_tdlr: We propose Skeleton-to-Image Encoding (S2I), which transforms skeleton sequences into image-like data by partitioning and arranging joints based on body-part semantics, enabling for the first time the use of powerful vision-pretrained models for self-supervised skeleton representation learning and integration of skeleton data into multi-modal action recognition without additional model branches.
